verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first email infrastructure, but it does have a human-facing console and dashboard, so a keyboard-driven, fast interface is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents keyboard shortcuts, a command palette, or interface speed for the console. The CLI and IMAP client access are different capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
